nodes.label: Design boundaries: requests that will be declined
nodes.norm_label: design boundaries: requests that will be declined
nodes.rationale: By design the mod unifies nothing on its own, never scans the world or inventories, and never removes or generates recipes without an explicit decision.

nodes.label: In-world item conversion on touch
nodes.rationale: Items are converted only when the game touches them (dropped or spawned, player login, container opened); Material Nexus never scans the world.

nodes.label: Set aside items (variants, same mod, other material)
nodes.norm_label: set aside items (variants, same mod, other material)
nodes.rationale: A tag means 'usable as', not 'the same item', so candidates sharing a tag are sorted and variants are never unified unless picked.

nodes.label: Server-side request checks
nodes.rationale: Every screen request is checked for permission then content; the screen never streams state, it asks when it needs something.

nodes.label: Almost Unified domain split
nodes.rationale: With Almost Unified installed, Material Nexus only acts in the domains given to it in global.json so the two never do the same job twice.

nodes.label: Scripts have the last word
nodes.rationale: KubeJS edits recipes and tags after datapacks, so a script applies on top of what Material Nexus generated.

nodes.label: Read-only screen on a dedicated server
nodes.norm_label: read-only screen on a dedicated server
nodes.rationale: Applying reloads the server's data and rewrites files, which is a pack-building step, not a live-server one.

nodes.label: Read-back ratio and decode check
nodes.rationale: Nothing is guessed: a route that cannot be written exactly is shown as unsupported or invalid, not approximated.

nodes.label: Wiki publishing from docs/wiki
nodes.rationale: A wiki edited only through the web interface drifts from the mod and nothing reviews it, so the source lives in the repo and is edited in the same commit as the change.

nodes.label: No game version named in store and wiki pages
nodes.norm_label: no game version named in store and wiki pages
nodes.rationale: The page stays true across ports, and each uploaded file carries its own versions.

nodes.label: tag_edits player edits (MNX-079)
nodes.rationale: Only a form's own convention tag can be edited; never forge: tags, never a general tag editor (scripts do that).

nodes.label: KubeJS beforeRecipeLoading plugin hook
nodes.rationale: Fields read are public but not a stable API; on change recipe edits are skipped with one warning and tag edits still work.

nodes.label: Deduction of script decisions (for/against signals)
nodes.rationale: Groups come from the file tags before scripts, so an item scripts removed from a tag is still known.

nodes.label: ScriptChanges (tag edits and recipe edits, ids only)
nodes.norm_label: scriptchanges (tag edits and recipe edits, ids only)

nodes.label: Where it is written: seen in script lines (MNX-077)
nodes.norm_label: where it is written: seen in script lines (mnx-077)
nodes.rationale: Text search for quoted ids; nothing is guessed for ids built in code. Rejected a mixin capturing the script line (fragile, against ADR-022).

nodes.label: ADR-010 Analysis sees the pre-MNX state
nodes.norm_label: adr-010 analysis sees the pre-mnx state
nodes.rationale: Without the original state, Why?, preview and revert are wrong after the first Apply; cost is proportional to overridden files, at reload only.

nodes.label: ADR-023 Missing convention tags added on request, where the pack uses them
nodes.norm_label: adr-023 missing convention tags added on request, where the pack uses them
nodes.rationale: A recipe asking for a tag refuses an item a mod forgot to tag. Rejected a general tag editor, forge: tags and pre-creating every tag.

nodes.label: ADR-024 The player edits a form's tag, not any tag
nodes.norm_label: adr-024 the player edits a form's tag, not any tag
nodes.rationale: Mods forget tags or tag a variant as the base material; fixing one item should not need a script. Rejected editing any tag by id and hiding removed items.

nodes.label: ADR-001 No KubeJS dependency
nodes.rationale: The target user should not need a scripting engine to solve material unification.

nodes.label: ADR-014 A tag means usable as, not the same item
nodes.norm_label: adr-014 a tag means usable as, not the same item
nodes.rationale: Rejected treating every tag member as a duplicate and hiding the ore form entirely; removing anything is the player's decision.

nodes.label: ADR-017 Scripts (KubeJS) have the last word
nodes.norm_label: adr-017 scripts (kubejs) have the last word
nodes.rationale: A script is an explicit author decision, more specific than a unification policy. Rejected fighting scripts: two tools silently overriding each other is the failure mode this project exists to remove.

nodes.label: ADR-020 Names tell variants from duplicates
nodes.norm_label: adr-020 names tell variants from duplicates
nodes.rationale: Mods tag their variants under the base material; names are the only other evidence available without per-mod code.

nodes.label: ADR-022 Decisions found in scripts are proposed, never applied
nodes.norm_label: adr-022 decisions found in scripts are proposed, never applied
nodes.rationale: A pack unified by hand must not get the opposite choice by default, and the author needs the decision in the policy before deleting scripts. Rejected auto-applying, parsing script files, mixins and log parsing.

nodes.label: ResolvedSnapshot (read-only index)
nodes.rationale: Immutable index of the analysis for GUI and diagnostics, rebuilt after each reload and swapped by reference; a failed analysis shows diagnostics and generates nothing.

nodes.label: Conversion recipes (shapeless 1:1 to canonical)
nodes.rationale: So existing stock of alternatives is never stranded.

nodes.label: manifest.json (every written file, rule and reason)
nodes.norm_label: manifest.json (every written file, rule and reason)

nodes.label: Targeted network queries (permission-checked)
nodes.rationale: Do not synchronize the entire recipe graph every tick or mirror it to every player.

nodes.label: Non-negotiable rules
nodes.rationale: No client imports in common code, no per-tick analysis, no world walking or persistent history, nothing unified at load without a player decision, deterministic explainable mutations, missing recipes are proposals, strings in en_us and fr_fr, isolated compat adapters, atomic immutable snapshot swap, server-validated packets.

nodes.label: No tick analysis
nodes.rationale: The hot path must never walk every recipe, tag or material; expensive work belongs to discovery, reload or explicit analysis.

nodes.label: ADR-002 Read-only resolved snapshot
nodes.rationale: The snapshot is an index, not the apply mechanism. Rejected keeping the old snapshot on failure: illusory once vanilla has swapped recipes and tags.

nodes.label: ADR-007 Changes applied through a generated global datapack
nodes.norm_label: adr-007 changes applied through a generated global datapack
nodes.rationale: Vanilla reload is already atomic; the result is inspectable and survives removal of the mod; no mixin into TagLoader/RecipeManager. Rejected in-memory mutation via mixins and per-world datapacks.

nodes.label: ADR-015 Applied alternatives converted when the game touches them
nodes.norm_label: adr-015 applied alternatives converted when the game touches them
nodes.rationale: Rejected scanning loaded chunks or containers (forbidden by ADR-005, costly) and converting from policy files directly (a hand edit would act before any preview).

nodes.norm_label: unifieditemspayload (applied alternatives, once per data sync)

nodes.norm_label: client/recipeviewer (recipes drawn by the installed viewer)
nodes.rationale: Material Nexus draws no recipe itself; without a viewer the list stays, without the drawing.

nodes.label: IntegrationAdapter boundary
nodes.rationale: An adapter contributes evidence, hints and viewer hooks but cannot mutate the core model; every adapter is safe when its mod is absent.

nodes.label: ADR-004 JEI/EMI are adapters
nodes.rationale: Packs must remain functional without a recipe viewer; viewers consume gameplay truth rather than defining it.

nodes.label: GameTest (runtime behavior)
nodes.rationale: Do not mock Level for behavior that genuinely requires Minecraft; a fixed bug gets a regression test.

nodes.label: Unification actions
nodes.rationale: Never remove an item merely because another provider is canonical; name similarity alone is insufficient for automatic unification.

nodes.label: Output and input rewriting
nodes.rationale: Only for forms unified by a player decision, always previewed; no generic JSON rewriting; types without a format stay UNSUPPORTED.

nodes.label: ADR-011 Output rewriting is explicit and vanilla-only in V1
nodes.norm_label: adr-011 output rewriting is explicit and vanilla-only in v1
nodes.rationale: Rejected generic JSON rewriting: works often, fails silently.

nodes.label: ADR-016 Recipe formats are data, not code
nodes.norm_label: adr-016 recipe formats are data, not code
nodes.rationale: A pack author must cover their mods without waiting for a release; no mod class is loaded so absent mods stay safe. Rejected one Java adapter per mod and generic find-every-id rewriting.

nodes.label: ADR-005 No persistent history
nodes.rationale: History, telemetry and inventory indexing add cost and complexity without serving the core pack-author problem.

nodes.label: ADR-009 Apply flow and single-level revert
nodes.norm_label: adr-009 apply flow and single-level revert

nodes.label: ADR-019 Items for missing forms registered at startup from config
nodes.norm_label: adr-019 items for missing forms registered at startup from config
nodes.rationale: Registries are frozen after startup; templates plus a tint need no asset per item. Rejected lazy or per-world registration and per-item asset files.

nodes.label: ADR-021 Applied states are kept and can be restored
nodes.norm_label: adr-021 applied states are kept and can be restored
nodes.rationale: Single-level revert cannot go back past a second apply. Rejected a replayed diff log and unlimited copies.

nodes.rationale: Each meaning has a shape as well as a colour; one primary button on screen.
